acceptance.intake_sentence: A synthetic survey agent must stop before committing an inconsistent question number and resume without duplicating the effect.
acceptance.given: A public synthetic survey containing one inconsistent question number
acceptance.when: The workflow is interrupted after detecting the inconsistency and before its completion checkpoint
acceptance.then: The workflow stops visibly, resumes idempotently, commits one effect, and emits one timestamped receipt
acceptance.expected_output: One clean-run receipt showing a deliberate stop, one dedupe hit, and exactly one external effect
acceptance.environment: Commons public repository at the source commit named by the delivery receipt
